meta.description: The DEFAULT six-face run in policy mode, with zero timed inputs: hold fire, hold right while the world is scrolling, back off (the scroll is frozen, so retreating is free) while a wave gate's message is up and there is daylight to the damage plane, hop on every landing, and dodge a houndframe the moment it plants for its charge. Everything is position- or state-triggered because a 100+ second run's event times move with every tuning change — the case the README's policy mode exists for. WHERE IT STOPS, AND WHY — MEASURED WITH REPEATS, NOT FROM ONE RUN (T-009's playtest gate, 3 runs per side, both trees pinned, 150 s cap, --deterministic, 1440x900; CITATION CORRECTED BY T-028 — the run directories every figure in this description was read from (tools/playtest/runs/gate-T-009-fullrun-{branch,branch-2,branch-3,main,main-2,main-3}, and the ?zip=1 pair below) are GITIGNORED and are not in the tree, and reports/tasks/T-009/playtest.md does not carry these numbers either; the only committed record of them is SPRINT.md's Inbox entry I-020. Read them as the gate's reported measurement, not as something re-checkable from this repo): task/T-009 reached maxX 89.25 / 89.25 / 110.65 (scroll 75 / 75 / 112) and a pristine snapshot of main reached 89.25 / 89.25 / 89.25 (scroll 75 x3). All six runs ended in GAME_OVER inside a wave gate fight; no run of this script on either tree has ever reached VICTORY. RETRACTED, DO NOT RE-QUOTE: the single-run-per-side A/B this description used to carry (branch maxX 154.3 / scroll 140 / 11 kills / 48.5 s vs main 89.3 / 75 / 8 / 27.1 s, three life losses at x 31.6 / 93.0 / 148.0, 'the lattice tree gets ~1.7x further') did not reproduce and was struck by the integrator as I-020. For scale on the harness noise: the same branch under ?zip=1 — a render-only flag whose simulation pathcheck proves identical — produced maxX 154.25 and 113.40, so the whole claimed lattice effect fits inside the spread of a flag that cannot touch the sim (playtest README 'Honesty / limitations' #2 and #8). What survives the repeats: both trees fail, main fails at the identical spot 3 times out of 3, and what stops the bot is the gate FIGHT — a reflex policy with no aim model against diving wasps in three lanes — not the geometry. The same policy driven through the sim with hostiles removed (tools/pathcheck.mjs, 'T-009: the run reaches the outro scroll end') crosses every face and every pocket chasm and reaches the outro with 2 lives. Use this script as the traversal+pressure smoke test it is. Proving boot-to-VICTORY is deliberately NOT this script's job and was split out of T-009 into its own task (T-018) by the integrator; do not retune waves or weaken pockets to move this number.

outcome.attemptsUnavailableReason: sliceStats.attempts is fixture-only — src/main.js increments it inside `if (ACTIVE_FIXTURE)` and this run is the default six-face run, so the counter is structurally frozen at its initial value here. Read outcome.deaths / metrics.lives.

servedFixture.source: window.HB.fixture + HB.snapshot() on the served page

outcome.attemptsUnavailableReason: sliceStats.attempts is fixture-only — src/main.js increments it inside `if (ACTIVE_FIXTURE)` and this run is the default six-face run, so the counter is structurally frozen at its initial value here. Read outcome.deaths / metrics.lives.

jumpCounts.note: sliceStats.airJumps resets to 0 on every retry/resetGame — these reflect the current attempt only, not a session total

metrics.deathsScope: stock lives spent on the default six-face run (player.lives decreases; fixtures do not spend lives, this run is not one). HULL FALLBACK absorptions (?fallback=1) cost no life — see metrics.score.setbacks — so a fallback-armed run's failure story is both numbers.

lives.note: stock lives spent, from player.lives on the telemetry channel. Inside a fixture this is 0 by design — fixtures retry instead of spending a life; metrics.deaths names the counter that applies to THIS run.

route.unavailableReason: the served build is running the DEFAULT six-face run (window.HB.snapshot().corner is present, so ACTIVE_FIXTURE === null): it authors no connectors, no routes and no dare pocket, so there is nothing for this metric to be computed against

protoScore.unavailableReason: the A.5 `links` term cannot be approximated on this build: the served build is running the DEFAULT six-face run (window.HB.snapshot().corner is present, so ACTIVE_FIXTURE === null): it authors no connectors, no routes and no dare pocket, so there is nothing for this metric to be computed against. Run with ?score=1 for the game's own event-derived link count (metrics.score), which needs no route matcher.
